scientific_integrity: Direct all-n proof from ordered-kernel/image cross-transversal conditions; standalone exact finite verification at n=2..18; novelty evaluated against identified source statements but not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only the rank-two and rank-(n-1) Green D-classes for n>=3 are treated; no assertion of an all-ranks involution matching, uniqueness, or inverse-semigroup structure. The finite computation is a check, not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Explicit inverse involutions on the two extreme nontrivial rank classes of order-preserving transformations
